prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: isolated URMAN game environment asset reference for subsequent image-to-3D, one modular rough-picket fence bay.
Input images: Image 1 existing actual runtime house-gate-approach screenshot is the geometry/construction-family reference: use only the ochre timber picket fence beyond the house's right corner. Image 2 owner-approved house frontal screenshot is the material/art-family reference: believable warm aged timber with restrained tactile grain and subdued chromatic painterly 3D surfaces, not a new environment.
Primary request: show ONE complete isolated fence bay, front-facing with a very slight three-quarter angle (about 10 degrees) so the thickness of the boards and rear bearing rails are readable. Full object, centered, wide horizontal composition, generous transparent margin, no cropping.
Construction: two square timber posts with centers 2.35 m apart, post sections 120 x 120 mm and crowns at 1.29 m; exactly THIRTEEN separate narrow upright pickets, each 95 mm wide and 28 mm thick. Nominal picket crowns 1.18 m, small purposeful hand-cut height variation of no more than 50 mm, restrained pointed tops. Readable open daylight gaps approximately 86 mm between pickets, with visible transparent background through them. Two horizontal structural bearing rails behind the pickets, real 45 x 75 mm timber sections, at heights 0.27 m and 0.95 m; each rail actually meets both support posts. Pickets are mounted to the rails as real pieces, thin in depth, never thick squared palisade logs. End pickets may overlap the front face alignment of the posts without intersecting their solid wood. Modest plain post caps are acceptable only as part of the posts. Posts have flat cut feet on the same base plane, no foundation platform.
Material/style: softly weathered muted ochre paint on warm dark brown wood, rubbed edges and restrained wood grain visible through worn paint, some darkened end grain and simple small iron fixings. Match the approved house's grounded stylized 3D material language; coherent carpenter-built rural Tatar village fence, no ornate new motifs and no cartoon exaggeration. Soft neutral broad illumination so material colors can be reconstructed; do not bake blue snow lighting, strong cast shadows or glossy dramatic studio highlights.
Constraints: exactly one bay, two posts, thirteen pickets and two rails. No gate, wicket or empty person-width opening. No solid backplate, no hidden sheet filling gaps, no woven fence, no horizontal rails across mid-height apart from the two specified structural rails. No snow, icicles, plants, ground, soil, rocks, floor, plinth, scenery, buildings, people, props, labels, text, measurement arrows, logo, watermark or multi-view collage. Transparent background and transparent spaces between pieces. This is a source reference, not a beauty shot of a complete scene.
